messages.subject: Re: surface models from nat.flybrains
parts:
Hi Jan,

Thanks for asking about appropriate citation. The answer depends on what
you are using.

If you are using the FCWB template then you should cite Chiang et al
2011 for the raw image data and Costa et al 2016 for the construction of
the template and surface models.

If you are using any of the cross registration tools (to move data
between template brains) then you should for the time being cite Manton
et al 2014 biorXiv – we hope to have a formal publication on this
sooner rather than later.

Of course you should point to the repository when you write up your
methods, but regrettably the only citations that help to support the
continued development of these kind of tools are those to journal
articles contained within the main body (not SI) of a paper.

All the best,

Greg.
